title: Skybridge: Bounded Staleness for Distributed Caches
problem: Distributed caching requires tradeoffs between consistency and performance; strict consistency limits scalability while eventual consistency allows staleness
motivation: AI systems use distributed caches for model serving and feature caching; bounded staleness provides better consistency guarantees than eventual consistency
method: Distributed cache system with bounded staleness consistency model
key_novelty: First practical bounded staleness implementation for distributed caches with explicit staleness bounds
contributions: Bounded staleness consistency model for distributed caches
Practical implementation with configurable staleness bounds
Better consistency than eventual consistency with scalability benefits
limitations: Title-only paper; performance/consistency tradeoffs not quantified; applicability to different cache workloads unclear
